per_question.question: The Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT) policy has been amended multiple times. Which change notice is the most recent, and what did it change?
per_question.agent_answer:
The most recent **change notice surfaced in the amendment records for MA-3550** is **Change Notice 04-22**. It changed the **Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)** policy by:

- **Reorganizing and updating MA-3550.VIII, Determining Need for Transportation Services**
- **Adding subsections** to make topics easier to locate
- **Moving information about failure to complete the assessment** from subsection A to a new subsection E, **Failure to complete the assessment**
- Amending **MA-3550.XI.A.13.D, Driving Records**; however, the parsed amendment summary I retrieved cuts off at that point, so I **could not verify the full substance of that Driving Records change** from the available text

Citations: [CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 04-22, Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT)](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/cn-04-22.pdf); [MA-3550 NON-EMERGENCY MEDICAL TRANSPORTATION (NEMT)](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/MA-3550-.pdf)

One important qualifier: the current MA-3550 manual itself shows a later revision marker, **“REVISED 03/16/2026 - CHANGE NO. 04-26.”** I verified that this is the latest revision marker on the manual, but the retrieved parsed text for that revision header is title-only, so I **could not confirm the specific substantive changes made by Change No. 04-26** from the available corpus text. Citation: [MA-3550 NON-EMERGENCY MEDICAL TRANSPORTATION (NEMT)](https://policies.ncdhhs.gov/wp-content/uploads/MA-3550-.pdf)

## Bottom line
- **Latest revision marker on the NEMT manual:** **Change No. 04-26**, revised **03/16/2026**
- **Most recent amendment with a retrievable change summary in the amendment records:** **Change Notice 04-22**, summarized above

If you want, I can next help identify **whether 04-26 has a separate change notice PDF** and compare it against 04-22.
